LanguageData.RP_StaffWarden: The warden on the floor - never let go, sent home or retrained
LanguageData.RP_TrainingWarden: The warden does not go on courses.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_WardenRetired: {0} came back to a post that {1} holds, and was let go.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_WardenAppointed: {0} was named the prison's warden on the floor.
LanguageData.RP_WardenNamedText: The state has named {0} to walk the floor as the prison's warden. They are among the staff. They can address the canteen, walk a wing and have a word with an inmate, and they are never sent home. They are also the one a riot would like to get its hands on.
LanguageData.RP_WardenWhy_Away: The warden is not on the floor.
LanguageData.RP_WardenWhy_Down: The warden is hurt or not themselves.
LanguageData.RP_WardenWhy_Busy: The warden is busy with something else.
LanguageData.RP_WardenWhy_NoCanteen: There is no canteen to speak in.
LanguageData.RP_WardenWhy_NoWing: There is no wing to walk.
LanguageData.RP_WardenWord_Gone: {0} did not have that word with {1}. It was not so any more.
LanguageData.RP_WardenAddressGizmoDesc:
The warden goes to the canteen and speaks to everyone in it.

Calm - tension down {0} for each of them, and their suppression eases by {1}.
Firm - suppression up {2} (fewer outbursts boil over), but tension then creeps up {3} an hour for {4} hours.

Nobody in the canteen, nothing happens. Ready again {5} h after.
LanguageData.RP_WardenAddressedCalm: {0} spoke plainly to the canteen. Inmates heard: {1}, and eased.
LanguageData.RP_WardenAddressedFirm: {0} laid down the law in the canteen. Inmates heard: {1}, and they went quiet.
LanguageData.RP_WardenAddressNobody: {0} found nobody in the canteen to speak to.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_WardenAddressCalm: {0} spoke calmly to the canteen (inmates heard: {1}).
LanguageData.RP_Chr_WardenAddressFirm: {0} laid down the law in the canteen (inmates heard: {1}).
LanguageData.RP_WardenWalkGizmoDesc: The warden walks a wing, stopping along it. Inmates in earshot who are calm trust the warden a little more; those who are wound up resent being watched. A snitch who is near may pass on something in person, and anyone with a complaint that has not reached the desk yet says it to the warden's face.\n\nReady again {0} h after.
LanguageData.RP_WardenWalked: {0} walked the {1}. Inmates met: {2}, warmer: {3}, resentful: {4}.
LanguageData.RP_WardenWordGizmoDesc: Pick an inmate. The warden goes to them and talks, about their goal if the warden knows of one, about informing, about where they stand before a hearing, or just a few words. One word with each inmate a day. Ready again {0} h after.
LanguageData.RP_WardenWord_GoalDesc: Three more days to make it (a slipping goal is lifted); a call home counts for a family goal; a grudge may be talked down (it may not take - they resent being told how to feel).
LanguageData.RP_WardenWord_Informant: Sound them out as an informant ({0} a day)
LanguageData.RP_WardenWord_InformantDesc: They may agree, more likely if they are afraid, broke and wound up, or trust the warden. Asking and being refused costs trust.
LanguageData.RP_WardenWord_Hearing: Tell them where they stand before the hearing
LanguageData.RP_WardenWord_HearingDesc: They calm down and go in prepared. The board's odds are a little better for a few days.
LanguageData.RP_WardenWord_ChatTold: {0} had a few words with the warden.
LanguageData.RP_WardenWord_HearingTold: {0} was told how the hearing stands, with the board's odds at {1}, and what is in the way, {2}.
LanguageData.RP_WardenWord_InformantYes: {0} will keep the warden informed, for {1} a day.
LanguageData.RP_WardenWord_InformantNo: {0} would not be drawn, and thinks the less of the warden for asking.
LanguageData.RP_Want_Backed: The warden backed {0}'s goal to {1} - three more days to make it.
LanguageData.RP_Want_Backed_Family: The warden let {0} make the call home. It counts toward their goal to {1}.
LanguageData.RP_Want_Backed_Score: The warden talked {0} out of their goal to {1}.
LanguageData.RP_Want_Backed_Score_Failed: {0} would not be talked out of their goal to {1}, and thinks the less of the warden for trying.
LanguageData.RP_Want_Reason_Talked: the warden talked them out of it
LanguageData.RP_WardenStruckText: {1} laid hands on {0}, the warden, on the floor. The guards will deal with it; the wing knows.
LanguageData.RP_WardenDiedText: {0}, the warden on the floor, died. {1}\n\nThe post is empty. The state will name another within {2} days.
LanguageData.RP_HostageWardenLabel: Hostage crisis - the warden, {0}, is held
LanguageData.RP_HostageWardenNote: It is the warden they have. {0} was the one they wanted. The stand-off is shorter, they will not talk for less, and if this goes wrong the prison's name will not recover soon.
